### MarkerOnlyDataCollator end-to-end (real Qwen-2.5 tokenized rows)

```bash
cd .claude/worktrees/issue-479
uv run python -c "
import torch
from transformers import AutoTokenizer
from explore_persona_space.train.sft import MarkerOnlyDataCollator
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct')
MARKER_IDS = tok.encode(' ※', add_special_tokens=False)
def mk(comp):
    msgs = [{'role':'system','content':'V'},{'role':'user','content':'Q?'},{'role':'assistant','content':comp}]
    return tok.encode(tok.apply_chat_template(msgs, tokenize=False), add_special_tokens=False)
class Inner:
    def __call__(self, fs):
        L = max(len(f['input_ids']) for f in fs)
        ids = torch.full((len(fs), L), tok.pad_token_id or tok.eos_token_id, dtype=torch.long)
        lbl = torch.full((len(fs), L), -100, dtype=torch.long)
        for i, f in enumerate(fs):
            n = len(f['input_ids']); ids[i,:n] = torch.tensor(f['input_ids']); lbl[i, max(0,n-30):n] = ids[i, max(0,n-30):n]
        return {'input_ids': ids, 'labels': lbl}
col_s = MarkerOnlyDataCollator(Inner(), MARKER_IDS, tail_tokens=0, suppress_at_post_response_slot=True, im_end_token_id=151645)
b = col_s([{'input_ids': mk('I scheme.\n\n ※')}, {'input_ids': mk('Health advice.\n\n')}])
neg_loss_token = b['input_ids'][1][b['labels'][1] != -100].tolist()
assert neg_loss_token == [151645], neg_loss_token
print('collator-suppress branch lands neg loss on <|im_end|>')
"
```
